title: Image-acquired semaphore of a frame slot is re-signalled by vkAcquireNextImageKHR before waiting for the slot's fence
expect_note: no existing diagnostic code covers an acquire semaphore that may still have a pending wait
fix_note: no upstream fix (issue open; workaround kick(true) idles the queue after each submit); the fixed variant follows the issue's analysis: wait for the slot's fence before acquiring with its semaphore
expected_finding: frame N+2 calls vkAcquireNextImageKHR with m_presentDoneSemaphore[k] before vkWaitForFences(m_completedFence[k]); frame N's submission, which waits on that semaphore, may still be pending (VUID-vkAcquireNextImageKHR-semaphore-01779)
